item.title: Americans’ Confidence in the US Economy Falls to Lowest Level Since 2014
item.description: The Conference Board said Tuesday that its consumer confidence index cratered 9.7 points to 84.5 in January, falling below even the lowest readings during the COVID-19 pandemic.
